I kept watching tweets move tokens.
You can bet on the price. But nobody lets you bet on the hype.
So I built Clout. Trade the hype, not the price.
First, I made the Clout Score. A live, zero to one hundred hype meter, built only from free, public trading data.
I paste a real tweet from the BONK account. Clout reads it, finds BONK, and shows its live score.
One click, and it becomes a yes or no market on Solana, powered by the P M A M M.
I bet yes with test U S D C, and the odds moved from fifty to fifty six percent.
Every market is also a Blink, so people can bet right from their X feed.
Then I went further. I built Clout Perps. Go long or short a token's hype, up to five x, with funding and liquidations, all on chain.
When a market closes, it settles itself on chain. This one went no.
That's Clout. Trade the hype, not the price.
